tasks.title: Add archivedAt to Issue type and archive methods to API client
tasks.description: Add `archivedAt?: string` field to the Issue interface in types.ts. Add four methods to api.ts: `archiveIssue(number)`, `unarchiveIssue(number)`, `archiveAllCompleted()`, and `getArchivedIssues()`. These call POST /api/issues/:number/archive, POST /api/issues/:number/unarchive, POST /api/issues/archive-completed, and GET /api/issues?archived=true respectively.
acceptanceCriteria: Issue interface in types.ts has archivedAt?: string field
api.ts has archiveIssue, unarchiveIssue, archiveAllCompleted, getArchivedIssues methods
getArchivedIssues sends GET /api/issues?archived=true
Typecheck passes

tasks.title: Add archive hooks to useQueries.ts
tasks.description: Add three hooks to useQueries.ts: `useArchivedIssues()` query hook using queryKey ['archived-issues'], `useArchiveIssue()` mutation hook calling api.archiveIssue, and `useUnarchiveIssue()` mutation hook calling api.unarchiveIssue. Both mutations must invalidate ['issues'] and ['archived-issues'] on success.
acceptanceCriteria: useArchivedIssues() query exists with queryKey ['archived-issues']
useArchiveIssue() mutation calls api.archiveIssue and invalidates ['issues'] and ['archived-issues']
useUnarchiveIssue() mutation calls api.unarchiveIssue and invalidates ['issues'] and ['archived-issues']
Typecheck passes

tasks.title: Add archive button to IssueCard and archive footer to StageColumn
tasks.description: Add `showArchiveButton` prop to IssueCard. When true and issue status is completed, render a 📦 icon button in the card top-right that calls archiveIssue mutation. Update StageColumn to accept `archivedCount` prop. When isDone is true and archivedCount > 0, render a footer showing '📦 N 已归档 [查看]' link to /archived and an '归档所有已完成' button that calls api.archiveAllCompleted. Button hidden when Done column has no issues. Use gray-toned subtle styling.
acceptanceCriteria: IssueCard shows 📦 archive button when showArchiveButton=true and status=completed
Archive button not shown when showArchiveButton=false or outside Done column

StageColumn Done footer shows archived count with /archived link when archivedCount > 0

归档所有已完成 button calls POST /api/issues/archive-completed and refreshes list
归档所有已完成 button disabled/hidden when Done column has no issues
Archive button shows disabled state during request
Footer uses gray-toned subtle styling (not primary blue)

tasks.title: Wire archived count through KanbanBoard and update KanbanView

KanbanView also uses useMutation for archiveAllCompleted, passing the mutate function down.

KanbanBoard receives and forwards archivedCount to StageColumn

tasks.title: Create ArchivedPage component with search and restore
tasks.description: Create ArchivedPage.tsx component. Fetch archived issues via useArchivedIssues hook. Display vertical list sorted by archivedAt descending. Each item shows number, title, archived time (relative), labels (using existing getLabelStyle), and a '恢复' restore button (using useUnarchiveIssue mutation). Items are clickable links to /issue/:number. Add search input for client-side title filtering. Add back button linking to /. Empty state when no archived issues. Use existing design language (white cards, shadow-sm, gray-100/60 background).
acceptanceCriteria: ArchivedPage fetches issues via useArchivedIssues and sorts by archivedAt descending
Each item displays number, title, completion time, archived time, labels, and restore button
Items link to /issue/:number
Restore button calls POST /api/issues/:number/unarchive and removes item from list
Restore button disabled during request
Search input filters issues by title case-insensitively
Clearing search shows all issues again
Back button navigates to /
Empty state shown when no archived issues
Styling matches existing design (white cards, shadow-sm, gray-100/60)
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Can be built in parallel with T-003/T-004 since it only depends on the hooks from T-002
